data.name: Fatemeh
data.gender_notes: Fatemeh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fatemeh is an Islamic name that symbolizes abundance and wealth, both material and spiritual. It is also the name of the daughter of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Fatemeh carries the meaning “Abundance, Wealth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatemeh usually hope their child will grow to embody abundance, wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fatemeh is considered a blessed name in Islamic tradition, associated with the virtues of the Prophet's family.
data.etymology: Fatemeh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Abundance, Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatemeh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_english.name: Fatemeh
in_english.meaning: Mohammedan, pure, chaste, salvation, compassion, heir
in_english.long_meaning: Fatemeh is the name of the most sacred woman in Islam, who is the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad and the mother of Imam Hassan and Imam Hussein. The name Fatemeh comes from the Arabic root Fatimah, which means purity, chastity, and salvation. It is also associated with compassion and kindness.

data.cultural_impact: Fatemeh is a beloved name in the Islamic world and holds great cultural significance. It is not only the name of Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) beloved daughter but also that of numerous other prominent women in Islamic history. The name Fatemeh is associated with devotion, purity, and strength, making it a highly respected and sought-after name for Muslim girls.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Fatemeh holds significant spiritual meaning in Islam. Fatemeh is known as the "Mother of the Martyrs" and is highly revered in Islamic tradition. She was an embodiment of patience, sacrifice, and love for her family and loved ones. Her spiritual significance can be seen in the Prophet's (pbuh) affection towards her, as he often expressed his deep love and admiration for her. Her life and character continue to inspire and guide Muslims to this day.
